title: Modern History: Leaders of Freedom Movement (Past Year Questions)

questions.q_en: Who wrote the patriotic song 'Sare Jahan Se Achha Hindustan Hamara' that was published in the weekly journal Ittehad on 16 August 1904?
questions.solution_en:
The patriotic song "Sare Jahan Se Achha Hindustan Hamara" (also known as "Tarana-e-Hindi") was written by the poet Muhammad Iqbal (Allama Iqbal). It was first published in the weekly journal Ittehad on August 16, 1904.

Explanation of Other Options:

• Chandrasekhar Azad: A prominent Indian revolutionary and freedom fighter.

• Rabindranath Tagore: A Nobel laureate, poet, philosopher, and composer who wrote India's national anthem, "Jana Gana Mana."

• Sardar Bhagat Singh: A charismatic Indian revolutionary and socialist who was a key figure in the Indian independence movement.

Further insights:

• Muhammad Iqbal (1877 - 1938) was an influential poet, philosopher, and politician in British India.

• "Sare Jahan Se Achha" quickly gained popularity and became an anthem of opposition to British rule in India.

• While Iqbal later became a prominent advocate for the creation of Pakistan, this early poem remains a widely cherished patriotic song in India.
questions.solution_hi: देशभक्ति गीत "सारे जहाँ से अच्छा हिंदुस्तान हमारा" (जिसे "तराना-ए-हिंदी" भी कहा जाता है) कवि मुहम्मद इकबाल (अल्लामा इकबाल) ने लिखा था। यह पहली बार 16 अगस्त 1904 को साप्ताहिक पत्रिका इत्तेहाद में प्रकाशित हुआ था।

questions.q_en: Who among the following Indian freedom fighters was fondly called Gandhi Buri (old lady Gandhi) for her dedication towards Gandhian principals?
questions.solution_en:
• Matangini Hazra was an Indian revolutionary who participated in the Indian independence movement until she was shot dead by the British Indian police in front of the Tamluk Police Station on 29 September 1942.

• She was affectionately known as Gandhi buri, Bengali for old lady Gandhi.
questions.solution_hi:
• मातंगिनी हाजरा एक भारतीय क्रांतिकारी थीं जिन्होंने भारतीय स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन में भाग लिया, यहाँ तक कि 29 सितंबर 1942 को तामलुक पुलिस थाने के सामने ब्रिटिश भारतीय पुलिस ने उन्हें गोली मारकर हत्या कर दी।

• उन्हें प्यार से गांधी बुरी, यानी बंगाली में 'बूढ़ी गांधी' कहा जाता था।

questions.q_en: 'Drain of Wealth', a critique of the colonial exploitation, was given by which of the following nationalist leaders?
questions.solution_en:
Dadabhai Naoroji, also known as the Grand Old Man of India, developed the Drain of Wealth Theory, which explained how Britain drained India's economic resources through:

I. Unfair trade practices - raw materials were exported cheaply, and finished goods were sold at high prices.

II. Salaries of British officials - paid from Indian revenues.

III. Home Charges - remittances sent to Britain.

His book "Poverty and Un-British Rule in India" provided statistical proof of this economic exploitation.
questions.solution_hi:
दादाभाई नौरोजी, जिन्हें भारत के 'ग्रैंड ओल्ड मैन' के रूप में भी जाना जाता है, ने धन के अपवाह सिद्धांत (Drain of Wealth Theory) विकसित किया, जिसने बताया कि ब्रिटेन ने भारत के आर्थिक संसाधनों को कैसे निकाला:

I. अनुचित व्यापार प्रथाएँ - कच्चा माल सस्ते में निर्यात किया जाता था, तैयार माल ऊँची कीमतों पर बेचा जाता था।

II. ब्रिटिश अधिकारियों के वेतन - भारत के राजस्व से भुगतान किए जाते थे।

questions.q_en: On 31 October 1940, who among the following was arrested for offering individual Satyagraha to protest against India's forced participation in the Second World War?
questions.solution_en:
The Individual Satyagraha (1940) was launched by Mahatma Gandhi as a non-violent protest against British policies during World War II.

· It was different from mass movements like the Quit India Movement (1942) and was limited to select leaders.

· Vinoba Bhave was the first Satyagrahi, followed by Jawaharlal Nehru as the second Satyagrahi.

· Nehru was arrested on 31 October 1940 for delivering anti-war speeches and demanding freedom of speech.

· Other notable leaders arrested during Individual Satyagraha:

o Brahma Dutt (Third Satyagrahi)

o Acharya Kripalani

o J.B. Kripalani

Thus, the correct answer is Jawaharlal Nehru.
questions.solution_hi:
व्यक्तिगत सत्याग्रह (1940) महात्मा गांधी द्वारा द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के दौरान ब्रिटिश नीतियों के विरुद्ध एक अहिंसक विरोध के रूप में शुरू किया गया था।

• यह भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन (1942) जैसे व्यापक आंदोलनों से भिन्न था और चुनिंदा नेताओं तक सीमित था।

• विनोबा भावे पहले सत्याग्रही थे, उनके बाद दूसरे सत्याग्रही जवाहरलाल नेहरू थे।

questions.q_en: Who among the following stated in 1902, India was not ruled for its benefit, but rather for the benefit of its conquerors?
questions.solution_en:
Annie Besant stated in 1902 that India was not ruled for its benefit, but rather for the benefit of its conquerors.

She was a prominent British social reformer and political activist who played a significant role in the Indian independence movement.

Explanation of Other Options:

• Bal Gangadhar Tilak: A prominent assertive nationalist leader, very critical of British rule.

• Lala Lajpat Rai: Another key assertive nationalist leader, also a strong critic of British economic exploitation.

• Sarojini Naidu: A prominent poet and political activist who became deeply involved in the independence movement, but her most active political phase was slightly later.

Further insights:

• Annie Besant's work through the Theosophical Society and her later political activism through the Home Rule League aimed to awaken Indian pride and demand self-governance.

• Her critique of British rule often focused on its detrimental impact on Indian culture, economy, and self-respect.

• If this specific quote is attributed to her in 1902, it would be an early expression of her strong pro-Indian and anti-colonial stance.
questions.solution_hi:
एनी बेसेंट ने 1902 में कहा था कि भारत पर उसके अपने लाभ के लिए नहीं, बल्कि उसके विजेताओं के लाभ के लिए शासन किया जा रहा है।

वे एक प्रमुख ब्रिटिश समाज सुधारक व राजनीतिक कार्यकर्ता थीं जिन्होंने भारतीय स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई।

questions.q_en: Which of the following statements is NOT true about C Rajagopalachari?
options_en: He was the ﬁrst Indian to become the Governor General of India
He was the founder of the Swatantra Party
He was a senior leader of the Congress
He was the ﬁrst recipient of the Padma Shree Award
questions.solution_en: C. Rajagopalachari was a prominent leader in Indian politics, serving as the first Indian Governor General of India and a senior figure in the Congress party. He later founded the Swatantra Party, advocating for economic liberalism and individual freedom. However, he was not the first recipient of the Padma Shree Award.
questions.solution_hi: सी. राजगोपालाचारी भारतीय राजनीति में एक प्रमुख नेता थे, जिन्होंने भारत के पहले भारतीय गवर्नर-जनरल के रूप में सेवा दी और कांग्रेस पार्टी में एक वरिष्ठ हस्ती थे। उन्होंने बाद में स्वतंत्र पार्टी की स्थापना की, जो आर्थिक उदारवाद व व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता की वकालत करती थी। हालाँकि, वे पद्म श्री पुरस्कार के पहले प्राप्तकर्ता नहीं थे।

questions.q_en: Who gave title of "Father of the Nation" to Mahatma Gandhi?
questions.solution_en: The title "Father of the Nation" was given to Mahatma Gandhi by Subhas Chandra Bose, who was a prominent Indian nationalist leader and a key figure in the Indian independence movement.
questions.solution_hi: "राष्ट्रपिता" की उपाधि महात्मा गांधी को सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने दी थी, जो एक प्रमुख भारतीय राष्ट्रवादी नेता व भारतीय स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन की एक प्रमुख हस्ती थे।

questions.q_en: In pre-independent India, who was the first person to discuss the concept of poverty line?
questions.solution_en: Dadabhai Naoroji, an Indian nationalist, social reformer, and early leader in the Indian independence movement, is often credited with discussing and popularizing the concept of a "poverty line."
questions.solution_hi: दादाभाई नौरोजी, एक भारतीय राष्ट्रवादी, समाज सुधारक व भारतीय स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन के प्रारंभिक नेता, को "गरीबी रेखा" की अवधारणा पर चर्चा करने व इसे लोकप्रिय बनाने का श्रेय अक्सर दिया जाता है।

questions.q_en: What is the name of the famous British social reformer known for founding the Indian Home Rule League in 1916?
questions.solution_en:
• Annie Besant was a prominent British social reformer, theosophist, and Indian nationalist.

• In 1916, she founded the Indian Home Rule League, advocating for self-governance (Home Rule) for India within the British Empire.

• She worked closely with Indian leaders and played a key role in mobilizing public opinion for the cause of Indian autonomy.

• She also became the first woman President of the Indian National Congress in 1917.

Other Options Explained:

• Maria Rye: British social reformer known for her work with orphaned children and emigration schemes to Canada, not connected to Indian politics.

• Catherine Osler: A British suffragist and women's rights activist, focused on British women's suffrage, not Indian independence.

• Anne Knight: An early British feminist and anti-slavery campaigner, predating Annie Besant, not involved in Indian nationalist movements.

Further Insight:

• The Indian Home Rule League movement was inspired by the Irish Home Rule movement.

• Along with Annie Besant, Bal Gangadhar Tilak also led a parallel Home Rule League in western India.

• The movement laid the groundwork for more assertive nationalist activities that followed, including the Non-Cooperation Movement led by Gandhi.
questions.solution_hi:
• एनी बेसेंट एक प्रमुख ब्रिटिश समाज सुधारक, थियोसॉफिस्ट व भारतीय राष्ट्रवादी थीं।

• 1916 में, उन्होंने भारतीय होम रूल लीग की स्थापना की, जो ब्रिटिश साम्राज्य के भीतर भारत हेतु स्वशासन (होम रूल) की वकालत करती थी।

• उन्होंने भारतीय नेताओं के साथ मिलकर निकटता से कार्य किया।

questions.q_en: Who among the following gave the famous 'Do or Die' slogan during Quit India Movement?
questions.solution_en:
Top of Form

During the Quit India Movement in 1942, Mahatma Gandhi gave the iconic 'Do or Die' slogan, urging the Indian people to adopt a decisive and unwavering stance against British colonial rule. The slogan became a rallying cry for the intensification of the independence struggle.
questions.solution_hi: 1942 में भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन के दौरान, महात्मा गांधी ने प्रसिद्ध 'करो या मरो' का नारा दिया, जिसमें भारतीय जनता से ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन के विरुद्ध एक निर्णायक व अडिग रुख अपनाने का आग्रह किया गया। यह नारा स्वतंत्रता संग्राम को तेज करने का आह्वान बना।

questions.q_en: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, who was the first Home Minister of India, is known by which sobriquet?
questions.solution_en:
· Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel is called the "Iron Man of India" due to his role in unifying the princely states into the Indian Union.

· He was instrumental in integrating over 560 princely states after independence.

· The title symbolizes his strength, determination, and firm leadership.

Further insights:

Grand Old Man of India - Dadabhai Naoroji

· He was one of the earliest Indian political leaders and a strong advocate for Indian self-rule.

· First Indian to be elected to the British Parliament.

· Known for his work on the Drain Theory, highlighting how British policies were economically exploiting India.

Raja Ram Mohan Roy

· A social and educational reformer, often considered the father of the Indian Renaissance.

· Advocated for the abolition of sati, child marriage, and promoted women's education and modern education.

· Founded the Brahmo Samaj in 1828.

Father of Indian Unrest - Bal Gangadhar Tilak

· A prominent freedom fighter and nationalist leader.

· Known for his assertive style of leadership and the slogan: "Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it."

· The British colonial authorities gave him this title due to his powerful and fiery speeches that stirred political awakening.
questions.solution_hi:
• सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल को रियासतों को भारतीय संघ में एकीकृत करने में उनकी भूमिका के कारण "भारत का लौह पुरुष" कहा जाता है।

• स्वतंत्रता के बाद 560 से अधिक रियासतों के एकीकरण में उनकी महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका रही।

• यह उपाधि उनकी शक्ति, दृढ़ संकल्प व मजबूत नेतृत्व का प्रतीक है।

questions.q_en: Lal Bahadur Shastri was born on _________.
questions.solution_en: Lal Bahadur Shastri, born on 2 October 1904, was a prominent Indian politician and statesman. He served as the second Prime Minister of India from 1964 to 1966, succeeding Jawaharlal Nehru. Shastri is remembered for his leadership during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1965 and for popularizing the slogan "Jai Jawan Jai Kisan" (Hail the Soldier, Hail the Farmer) to boost morale and emphasize the importance of both the military and agriculture in nation-building.
questions.solution_hi: लाल बहादुर शास्त्री, जिनका जन्म 2 अक्टूबर 1904 को हुआ, एक प्रमुख भारतीय राजनेता व राजनयिक थे। उन्होंने जवाहरलाल नेहरू के उत्तराधिकारी के रूप में 1964 से 1966 तक भारत के दूसरे प्रधानमंत्री के रूप में सेवा दी। शास्त्री को 1965 के भारत-पाकिस्तान युद्ध के दौरान उनके नेतृत्व व "जय जवान जय किसान" नारे को लोकप्रिय बनाने के लिए याद किया जाता है।

questions.q_en: Being the President of the Indian National Congress, who among the following had called for complete independence from the British Raj in 1929?
questions.solution_en: At the Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress in 1929, Jawaharlal Nehru, as the President, passed the resolution for Purna Swaraj (Complete Independence) and declared 26th January 1930 as Independence Day.
questions.solution_hi: 1929 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के लाहौर अधिवेशन में, जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने अध्यक्ष के रूप में पूर्ण स्वराज (संपूर्ण स्वतंत्रता) का प्रस्ताव पारित किया और 26 जनवरी 1930 को स्वतंत्रता दिवस के रूप में घोषित किया।

questions.q_en: Who among the following was one of the leaders who was instrumental in convincing Mahatma Gandhi about the need to start a non-cooperation movement in support of The Khilafat?
questions.solution_en:
Shaukat Ali was one of the leaders who was instrumental in convincing Mahatma Gandhi about the need to start a non-cooperation movement in support of The Khilafat.

Khilafat movemen was a pan-Islamic force in India that arose in 1919 in an effort to salvage the Ottoman caliph as a symbol of unity among the Muslim community in India during the British raj. The movement was initially bolstered by Gandhi's noncooperation movement but fell apart after the abolition of the caliphate in 1924.

The combined Khilafat Non-Cooperation movement was the first all-India agitation against British rule.
questions.solution_hi:
शौकत अली उन नेताओं में से एक थे जिन्होंने महात्मा गांधी को खिलाफत के समर्थन में असहयोग आंदोलन शुरू करने की आवश्यकता के बारे में मनाने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई।

खिलाफत आंदोलन भारत में एक पैन-इस्लामिक शक्ति थी जो 1919 में उठी।

questions.q_en: Veer Surendra Sai was a freedom fighter from:
questions.solution_en: Veer Surendra Sai (23 January 1809 - 28 February 1884) was a native Indian as well as a regional freedom fighter from the Bengal Presidency, now Odisha. He fought against British rule in India after they dethroned the king and queen of Sambalpur State as he was the legal heir.
questions.solution_hi: वीर सुरेंद्र साई (23 जनवरी 1809 - 28 फरवरी 1884) बंगाल प्रेसीडेंसी, अब ओडिशा, से एक मूल भारतीय व क्षेत्रीय स्वतंत्रता सेनानी थे। उन्होंने भारत में ब्रिटिश शासन के विरुद्ध लड़ाई लड़ी, जब उन्होंने संबलपुर राज्य के राजा-रानी को पदच्युत कर दिया था, क्योंकि वे कानूनी उत्तराधिकारी थे।

questions.q_en:
Match the following movements with their respective founders:

a. Faraizi MovementI. Sayyid Ahmad of Rae Bareli
b. Mohammedan Literary SocietyII. Sir Syed Ahmad Khan
c. Indian Patriotic AssociationIII. Nawab Abdul Latif
d. Wahabi MovementIV. Haji Shariatullah
options_en: a - IV , b -III, c -II, d - I
a -III b  -  IV, c - II, d - I
a -II, b  -  I, c  -  IV, d -III
a  -  I, b  -  II, c -III, d - IV
options_hi: a - IV , b -III, c -II, d - I
a -III b  -  IV, c - II, d - I
a -II, b  -  I, c  -  IV, d -III
a  -  I, b  -  II, c -III, d - IV
questions.solution_en:
· Faraizi Movement: This socio-religious reform movement in Eastern Bengal in the early 19th century was founded by IV. Haji Shariatullah.

· Mohammedan Literary Society: Founded in Calcutta in 1863 to promote modern education and discuss political, social, and religious issues among Muslims, its founder was III. Nawab Abdul Latif.

· Indian Patriotic Association: This was founded by II. Sir Syed Ahmad Khan in 1888, along with Raja Shiv Prasad of Benaras, to counter the propaganda of the Indian National Congress and promote loyalty to the British.

· Wahabi Movement (also known as Tariqah-i-Muhammadiyah in India): This revivalist Islamic movement in India in the 19th century was significantly led and popularized by I. Sayyid Ahmad of Rae Bareli (also known as Syed Ahmed Barelvi).

Further insights:

• Faraizi Movement: Focused on adherence to the obligatory duties (faraiz) of Islam and opposed un-Islamic customs. It also had an agrarian character, fighting for the rights of peasants.

• Mohammedan Literary Society: Played a crucial role in the intellectual awakening of Muslims in Bengal by encouraging Western education alongside religious learning.

• Indian Patriotic Association: Formed to oppose the Indian National Congress and demonstrate Muslim loyalty to British rule, reflecting Sir Syed Ahmad Khan's political stance at the time.

• Wahabi Movement: Aimed to purify Islam and return to its original principles. It had both religious and political dimensions, including armed struggle against the Sikhs and later the British.
questions.solution_hi:
• फराइजी आंदोलन: 19वीं सदी की शुरुआत में पूर्वी बंगाल में यह सामाजिक-धार्मिक सुधार आंदोलन हाजी शरीयतुल्लाह ने स्थापित किया था।

• मुहम्मडन लिटरेरी सोसाइटी: 1863 में कलकत्ता में मुसलमानों में आधुनिक शिक्षा को बढ़ावा देने व राजनीतिक, सामाजिक व धार्मिक मुद्दों पर चर्चा हेतु स्थापित।

questions.q_en: Who founded the Bombay Presidency Association in 1885 along with Pherozeshah Mehta and K.T. Telang?
questions.solution_en:
· The Bombay Presidency Association was founded in 1885 by:

o Badruddin Tyabji (first Muslim INC president)

o Pherozeshah Mehta (Indian nationalist leader)

o K.T. Telang (jurist and social reformer)

· It aimed to protect the rights of Indians under British rule.

· Tyabji was also the first Muslim president of the Indian National Congress.
questions.solution_hi:
• बॉम्बे प्रेसीडेंसी एसोसिएशन की स्थापना 1885 में इनके द्वारा हुई:

o बदरुद्दीन तैयबजी (पहले मुस्लिम INC अध्यक्ष)

o फिरोजशाह मेहता (भारतीय राष्ट्रवादी नेता)

o के.टी. तेलंग (न्यायविद व समाज सुधारक)

• इसका उद्देश्य ब्रिटिश शासन के अधीन भारतीयों के अधिकारों की रक्षा करना था।

questions.q_en: Khudai Khidmatgar, a voluntary organization, was established by which of the following leaders of India?
questions.solution_en: Khudai Khidmatgar (Servants of God) was a non-violent movement started by Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan, also known as Frontier Gandhi. The movement aimed at social reform and independence from British rule, emphasizing peaceful resistance and civil disobedience.
questions.solution_hi: खुदाई खिदमतगार (ईश्वर के सेवक) खान अब्दुल गफ्फार खान, जिन्हें सीमांत गांधी भी कहा जाता है, द्वारा शुरू किया गया एक अहिंसक आंदोलन था। इस आंदोलन का उद्देश्य सामाजिक सुधार व ब्रिटिश शासन से स्वतंत्रता प्राप्त करना था, जो शांतिपूर्ण प्रतिरोध व सविनय अवज्ञा पर बल देता था।

questions.q_en: In which of the following years was VD Savarkar sent to Andaman Jail by the British?
questions.solution_en: Vinayak Damodar Savarkar was sentenced to two life terms of imprisonment in 1910 for his involvement in revolutionary activities against British rule. He was sent to the Cellular Jail in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands in 1911.
questions.solution_hi: विनायक दामोदर सावरकर को ब्रिटिश शासन के विरुद्ध क्रांतिकारी गतिविधियों में शामिल होने के लिए 1910 में दो आजीवन कारावास की सजा सुनाई गई थी। उन्हें 1911 में अंडमान-निकोबार द्वीप समूह की सेल्युलर जेल भेजा गया था।

questions.q_en: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose wrote the book:
options_en: Poverty and Un-British Rule in India
questions.solution_en: "The Indian Struggle" is a seminal work written by Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose, detailing the Indian independence movement and his role within it. The book provides insights into Bose's perspective on British rule in India and his vision for achieving independence through revolutionary means.
questions.solution_hi: "द इंडियन स्ट्रगल" नेताजी सुभाष चंद्र बोस द्वारा लिखा गया एक महत्वपूर्ण कार्य है, जो भारतीय स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन व उसमें उनकी भूमिका का विवरण देता है। यह पुस्तक भारत में ब्रिटिश शासन पर बोस के दृष्टिकोण व क्रांतिकारी तरीकों से स्वतंत्रता प्राप्त करने के उनके दृष्टिकोण की जानकारी देती है।
